expectation: I expect the fine grains to disperse or leave the disk, though their fate is uncertain.

effect: Radiation drives the selected small grains outward, leaving them available to meet the escaping gas.
reaction: The distinction between small grains and larger solids was interesting.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action and follows the expelled material into its surroundings.
expectation: I expect the grains to mix with the escaped gas outside the disk, though their longer-term fate is uncertain.

effect: The expelled grains mixed with escaping gas, completing the remaining goal and showing disk material returning to the surroundings.
reaction: The contrast between retained worlds and dispersed disk material was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the remnant belt was most worthwhile: it brought together rocky debris and the dry remains of the inward icy body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Driving out the fine grains felt somewhat routine after following the escaping gas, though the distinction in their behavior was useful.

surprise.text: I was interested that stellar radiation drives the selected small grains outward without automatically carrying larger solids along.

arbitrary.text: The final mixing was the only offered gameplay action and its purpose was clear; no action particularly felt arbitrary.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the way the debris histories converged and disk material returned to its surroundings made me curious about what happens next.
